notes:
Only Layercake.usp_load_brnz_corporate_subscription changes (MIG-0027). The down script restores the MOD-024 version. Every source row is still staged with Contact No and Scheme No NOT NULL, so a NULL in either still fails with 515 before bronze is touched, whether or not the row has a Sub Campaign Year (RULE-137). The staging column for Sub Campaign Year now allows NULL. Undated rows are left out of the RULE-128 choice, the repeat count and the RULE-130 distinct-key check. They are counted, 0 when there are none, as the sub-step 'no_campaign_year_rows_not_landed', written beside 'repeated_key_rows_not_landed' under the load's log_id. A failed run writes neither sub-step. A key whose rows all lose their year is soft-deleted, and it is restored when the year comes back. The table, its readers and usp_run_payment_segments are unchanged. For the Tester's regression run: TC-004-023 and TC-024-019, where a NULL Sub Campaign Year fails with 515, are superseded by REQ-023 and will fail until they are amended, as MP-001 MOD-025 says. The NULL Contact No and Scheme No conditions still hold. Unit tests (test_MOD025_dev) cover: undated rows counted one by one, with only dated rows counting as repeats; soft-delete and then restore of a key whose year goes missing and comes back; and the error path for a NULL Scheme No on an undated row (logs Failed, writes no sub-step, bronze unchanged).

Test-first: the first run had 0 of 18 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 18 of 18 and 3 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
